metric_notes.e2e: Output tokens / measured generate wall time. Model load, tokenization and warmup excluded; scheduling, prefill, decode included.
metric_notes.decode_only: Emission tokens strictly after all requests have first tokens / time from latest first-token timestamp to last emission; sum across rounds.
metric_notes.prefill_service: Per-request native scheduled-to-first-emission service span; includes sampling and initial Vegas draft; queue is excluded.
metric_notes.prefill_forward_stream: CUDA-event target-forward spans for each request while its prompt is processed; shared batch service time is NOT divided by batch.
metric_notes.tpot: Per-request (last emission - first emission) / (output tokens - 1); speculative multi-token bursts are amortized, not individual token arrival intervals.
metric_notes.overhead: Nested CUDA stream spans include launch gaps. target_forward includes collection/reduce/topk; draft includes slot mapping. Rejection excludes recomputed draft probabilities; sampling_and_draft_probs includes them. Do not sum overlapping spans.
metric_notes.acceptance: Direct counters in greedy/random rejection kernel accept branches, before max_tokens/EOS truncation. Denominator is drafts actually passed to verification; unused final drafts excluded. Accepted tokens per verification is per REQUEST iteration, excludes recovered/bonus tokens; batch iteration count reported separately.
metric_notes.memory: Peak total device NVML sampled every 10ms during measurement, includes display/allocator/KV reservation. PyTorch peaks separately reported.
metric_notes.progress: tqdm counts real emitted output tokens for warmup/measurement/profile separately. Console update cost during generate is included; use --no-progress on BOTH methods for runs without display overhead.
metric_notes.limits: Eager, synchronous, single GPU; no penalties/bad words/custom logits processors. Dataset benchmark measures speed, not task accuracy.

overhead_profile.note: Separate profiled batch, excluded from primary metrics; event overhead can inflate spans.
